restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes: eight 32-bit point lanes followed by eight 32-bit salt lanes, little-endian.
Single salted van Oorschot-Wiener distinguished-point rho walk of exactly k=2^128+2^40 compressions; no restart.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256; 2 prefix rounds; one 64-byte root block with flags 11, length 64, counter 0.
Classical 256-bit word RAM; distinguished when point lane 0 is zero (theta=2^-32); D_max=2^112 records.
Success probability 0.39 depends on score-critical heuristic H1-salted-random-mapping; time and memory caps are worst-case and heuristic-free.
Analytical generic construction near the birthday bound; no full-scale execution or precomputed collision is claimed.
The nominal reference identifier does not assert an improvement over 128; the claimed scalar 128.11 is a charged-overhead bound above the birthday exponent.

heuristics.statement: For a uniformly random salt and an independent uniform start point, the failure probability of the distinguished-point rho events A-G on the real salted 2-round BLAKE3 walk map f_s is at most the corresponding probability for a uniform random function on 2^256 points, up to a negligible additive gap covered by the 0.0034 allowance between the random-function bound (>0.3934) and the claimed success probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Applies only to the success-probability claim for this salted single-trail DP-rho algorithm with the stated parameters (k'=2^128, theta=2^-32, g=2^40, D_max=2^112). It does not assert anything about unsalted fixed maps, parallel multi-trail statistics beyond the charged single walk, differential cryptanalysis, or sub-birthday structure.
heuristics.extrapolation: The organizer-scaled experiment uses a 16-bit truncation of the same 2-round root compression with proportional DP parameters. Agreeing rho statistics there, together with the standard generic-hash modeling premise for salted walks, are extrapolated across about 240 bits of digest to the full 256-bit map. No proof rules out a global permutation-like structure that would suppress collisions.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is not proved. Truncated experiments cannot detect global injectivity or other large-structure deviations of the full map. The 0.0034 allowance above 0.39 is not statistically certified at full scale. Only the scaled experiment is organizer-executed; no full-scale collision is known. A map closer to a permutation would lower success probability below the claim.
